diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-1 Cross sectional view of rear axle
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional assembly diagram of rear axle and drive shaft showing wheel bearings, housing, companion flange, brake drum, axle shaft, and both R180 side yoke and R200 side flange configurations.

callouts.A: Tightening torque: 4.0 to 5.3 kg-m (29 to 38 ft-lb)
callouts.B: Tightening torque: 25 to 33 kg-m (181 to 239 ft-lb)
callouts.C: Tightening torque: Steel wheel 8.0 to 9.0 kg-m (58 to 65 ft-lb), Aluminum wheel 8.0 to 10.0 kg-m (58 to 72 ft-lb)
callouts.D: Tightening torque: 5.0 to 6.0 kg-m (36 to 43 ft-lb)
callouts.E: Tightening torque: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Flange bolt torque (A): 4.0 to 5.3 kg-m (29 to 38 ft-lb)
Axle bearing lock nut torque (B): 25 to 33 kg-m (181 to 239 ft-lb)
Wheel nuts torque (C, steel): 8.0 to 9.0 kg-m (58 to 65 ft-lb)
Wheel nuts torque (C, aluminum): 8.0 to 10.0 kg-m (58 to 72 ft-lb)
Drive shaft bolts torque (D): 5.0 to 6.0 kg-m (36 to 43 ft-lb)
Side yoke bolt torque (E): 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Two types of drive shafts: Side Flange type for R200 differential (M/T), Side Yoke type for R180 differential (A/T). Side yoke type inset coded RA415.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-2 Rear suspension system
diagrams.description: Complete schematic layout of the rear suspension system including strut assembly, transverse link, differential case mounting members, insulator mounts, stabilizer bar, and all torque specifications.

callouts.A: Tightening torque: 2.5 to 3.5 kg-m (18 to 25 ft-lb)
callouts.B: Tightening torque: 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
callouts.C: Tightening torque: 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
callouts.D: Tightening torque: 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)
callouts.E: Tightening torque: R180 Diff. 6.0 to 7.0 kg-m (43 to 51 ft-lb), R200 Diff. 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
callouts.F: Tightening torque: 14 to 16 kg-m (101 to 116 ft-lb)
callouts.G: Tightening torque: 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
callouts.H: Tightening torque: 1.0 to 1.2 kg-m (7 to 9 ft-lb)
callouts.I: Tightening torque: 6.0 to 8.0 kg-m (43 to 58 ft-lb)
callouts.J: Tightening torque: 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: A (strut mounting upper nut): 2.5 to 3.5 kg-m (18 to 25 ft-lb)
B (strut piston rod lock nut): 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
C (transverse link outer self-lock nut): 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
D (transverse link mounting brace bolt): 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)
E (differential rear member installation nut): R180 Diff. 6.0 to 7.0 kg-m (43 to 51 ft-lb), R200 Diff. 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
F (transverse link inner bolt): 14 to 16 kg-m (101 to 116 ft-lb)
G (differential rear insulator installation nut): 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
H (stabilizer bar connecting bolt): 1.0 to 1.2 kg-m (7 to 9 ft-lb)
I (gear carrier and front insulator nut): 6.0 to 8.0 kg-m (43 to 58 ft-lb)
J (differential front member bolt): 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Illustrates relationship of strut, coil spring, transverse link, differential mounting front and rear members, and stabilizer linkage.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-3 Removing drive shaft
diagrams.description: Removing drive shaft installation bolts at the rear axle wheel companion flange.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 5.0 to 6.0 kg-m (36 to 43 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bolts connect drive shaft flange to rear axle companion flange.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-4 Removing rear wheel bearing lock nut
diagrams.description: Removing the staked rear wheel bearing lock nut using tool KV40101000 while hub is stationary.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 25 to 33 kg-m (181 to 239 ft-lb)
Special tool: KV40101000
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not release caulking when removing the rear wheel bearing lock nut.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-5 Removing rear axle shaft
diagrams.description: Pulling the rear axle shaft out of the bearing housing using sliding hammer ST36230000 attached to rear axle stand KV40101000.
measurements_and_specs: Special tools: KV40101000, ST36230000
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Thread slide hammer adapter onto wheel hub studs/flange via KV40101000 stand.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-6 Removing rear wheel bearing (outer side)
diagrams.description: Pressing the outer rear wheel bearing off the axle shaft using a press and support plates.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not reuse bearing after removal.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-7 Rear bearing housing and distance piece
diagrams.description: Marking positions and dimension definitions for rear bearing housing length (L1) and distance piece length (L2).

callouts.Mark: Mark stamped location (A, B, or C)

measurements_and_specs: Mark A housing: 52.63 to 52.73 mm (2.0720 to 2.0760 in)
Mark A distance piece: 52.60 to 52.66 mm (2.0709 to 2.0732 in)
Mark B housing: 52.53 to 52.63 mm (2.0681 to 2.0720 in)
Mark B distance piece: 52.50 to 52.56 mm (2.0669 to 2.0693 in)
Mark C housing: 52.43 to 52.53 mm (2.0642 to 2.0681 in)
Mark C distance piece: 52.40 to 52.46 mm (2.0630 to 2.0654 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Select distance piece having a mark corresponding to mark on housing. When distance piece is reused, verify ends are not collapsed or deformed.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-8 Lubrication chart of rear axle
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional lubrication diagram of rear axle housing indicating cavity areas to pack with multi-purpose grease (asterisk *).
measurements_and_specs: Lock nut torque: 25 to 33 kg-m (181 to 239 ft-lb)
Preload: 4.5 kg-cm (3.9 in-lb), <= 790 gr (27.86 oz) at hub bolt
End play: 0 to 0.15 mm (0 to 0.0059 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Outer bearing has seal on one side. Install outer bearing so seal faces the wheel. Fill portions marked with asterisk (*) with grease.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-9 Drive shaft components
diagrams.description: Exploded view of drive shaft assembly showing components for both Side Flange type (R200) and Side Yoke type (R180).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Shows ball spline assembly order and universal joint spider yokes.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-10 Removing drive shaft
diagrams.description: Removing universal joint yoke flange bolts from both wheel and differential sides on R200 drive shaft.

callouts.A: Tightening torque: 5.0 to 6.0 kg-m (36 to 43 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque (A): 5.0 to 6.0 kg-m (36 to 43 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove bolts from both ends (wheel side and gear carrier side).

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-11 Removing side yoke fitting bolt
diagrams.description: Loosening center side yoke retaining bolt on R180 differential carrier.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove side yoke fitting bolts and extract side yokes together with drive shafts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-12 Measuring drive shaft play
diagrams.description: Dial gauge setup measuring spline play in the drive shaft assembly while fully compressed.
measurements_and_specs: Drive shaft play limit: 0.1 mm (0.004 in)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure drive shaft play with drive shaft completely compressed. If play exceeds 0.1 mm (0.004 in), replace drive shaft assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-13 Cross-sectional view of drive shaft
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional detail of universal joint needle bearing and drive shaft sleeve yoke showing grease packing area.
measurements_and_specs: Grease for ball rolling groove and oil groove: approximately 10 gr (0.35 oz)
Grease for sleeve yoke cavity: approximately 35 gr (1.23 oz)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply recommended multi-purpose grease to specified cavity. Drive shaft components are not available as separate service parts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-14 Removing brake hose and side brake linkage
diagrams.description: Disconnecting the brake line tube flare connector (body side) and emergency side brake cable linkage at rear wheel.

callouts.A: Tightening torque: 1.5 to 1.8 kg-m (11 to 13 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque (A): 1.5 to 1.8 kg-m (11 to 13 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use suitable tube wrench; never use open-end or adjustable wrench. Cover brake hose and pipe openings to prevent dirt ingress.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-15 Removing stabilizer from transverse link
diagrams.description: Detaching the rear stabilizer bar connecting link from transverse link mount.

callouts.A: Tightening torque: 1.0 to 1.2 kg-m (7 to 9 ft-lb)
callouts.B: Tightening torque: 1.2 to 1.7 kg-m (9 to 12 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque (A): 1.0 to 1.2 kg-m (7 to 9 ft-lb)
Tightening torque (B): 1.2 to 1.7 kg-m (9 to 12 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note bushing orientation and sequence on connecting rod.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-16 Removing lock bolt and self-lock nuts
diagrams.description: Removing transverse spindle lock bolt and outer spindle self-locking nuts from lower strut housing.

callouts.A: Tightening torque: 1.0 to 1.2 kg-m (7 to 9 ft-lb)
callouts.B: Tightening torque: 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Lock bolt torque (A): 1.0 to 1.2 kg-m (7 to 9 ft-lb)
Self-lock nuts torque (B): 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove lock bolt completely before driving out spindle.

diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/RA Rear axle and Suspension/fig_ra_17_removing_spindle.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-17 Removing spindle
diagrams.description: Withdrawing the rear transverse link spindle through the lower strut housing.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Drive spindle out gently so as not to damage threads.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-18 Removing strut installation nuts
diagrams.description: Removing upper strut insulator mounting nuts from inside the passenger / luggage compartment under the trim.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 2.5 to 3.5 kg-m (18 to 25 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Accessed from passenger compartment side. Support strut from below when loosening.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-19 Removing strut assembly
diagrams.description: Lowering the rear strut and brake drum assembly down out of the rear wheel well.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Place a jack under lower end of strut, and remove it gradually.

diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/RA Rear axle and Suspension/fig_ra_20_spindle.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-20 Spindle
diagrams.description: Dimensional diagram of transverse link rear spindle showing lock notch offset and length asymmetry.
measurements_and_specs: Shorter length from lock bolt position: 122.7 mm (4.831 in)
Longer length from lock bolt position: 131.5 mm (5.18 in)
Shaft diameter: 16 mm (0.63 in)
Lock notch width: 13.5 mm (0.531 in)
Thread size: M12 x 1.25 mm
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Install spindle so that shorter side (when measured from position where lock bolt is installed) faces front of car.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-21 Removing transverse link inner bolts
diagrams.description: Loosening the inner pivot bolts of the transverse link at the differential front crossmember.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 14 to 16 kg-m (101 to 116 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Loosen front side transverse link inner bolts when removing differential.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-22 Removing drive shaft installation bolts (wheel side)
diagrams.description: Disconnecting drive shaft bolts from companion flange at the wheel side.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 5.0 to 6.0 kg-m (36 to 43 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten to 5.0 to 6.0 kg-m (36 to 43 ft-lb) on reassembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-23 Loosening drive shaft installation bolts (gear carrier side)
diagrams.description: Disconnecting drive shaft flange bolts from the differential side companion flange.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 5.0 to 6.0 kg-m (36 to 43 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applies to R200 side flange type. For R180 side yoke, refer to Fig. RA-11.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-24 Removing differential mounting rear member
diagrams.description: Removing nuts securing the differential rear cover to the transverse rear mounting leaf member.
measurements_and_specs: R180 Diff. torque: 6.0 to 7.0 kg-m (43 to 51 ft-lb)
R200 Diff. torque: 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Place jack beneath gear carrier before removing rear member nuts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-25 Removing differential mounting front member
diagrams.description: Removing bolts securing the front crossmember of the differential to the underbody frame.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Lower jack slowly and remove gear carrier and front mounting member as an assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-26 Removing damper plate bolts and mounting front insulator nuts
diagrams.description: Removing damper plate bolts, front mounting insulator nuts, and differential case insulator retaining nuts.

callouts.1: Front mounting damper plate installation bolt
callouts.2: Front mounting member and front insulator installation nut
callouts.3: Gear carrier and front insulator installation nut
callouts.A: Tightening torque: 1.6 to 2.1 kg-m (12 to 15 ft-lb)
callouts.B: Tightening torque: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
callouts.C: Tightening torque: 6.0 to 8.0 kg-m (43 to 58 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Bolt 1 / Torque A: 1.6 to 2.1 kg-m (12 to 15 ft-lb)
Nut 2 / Torque B: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
Nut 3 / Torque C: 6.0 to 8.0 kg-m (43 to 58 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Torque nuts and bolts to specified values upon reinstallation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-27 Removing transverse link inner bolts
diagrams.description: Loosening rear side inner transverse link pivot bolts at rear link mounting brackets.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Loosen rear side transverse link inner bolts before unbolting bracket.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-28 Removing rear bracket
diagrams.description: Removing bolts securing the transverse link mounting rear bracket to the vehicle body.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten rear bracket bolts to 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb).

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-29 Removing link mounting brace and differential mounting member installation bolts
diagrams.description: Removing transverse link brace bolts and differential rear mounting insulator bolts at body anchor points.

callouts.1: Transverse link mounting brace installation bolt
callouts.2: Differential mounting rear insulator installation bolt
callouts.A: Tightening torque: 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)
callouts.B: Tightening torque: 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Brace bolt 1 / Torque A: 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)
Insulator bolt 2 / Torque B: 7.5 to 9.5 kg-m (54 to 69 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Support member while loosening insulator bolts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-30 Sectional view of differential mounting insulators
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional inspection diagram of differential front insulator showing clearance dimension 'A'.
measurements_and_specs: Dimension A limit: Replace if 9 mm (0.35 in) or greater, or 2 mm (0.08 in) or smaller (unloaded)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Replace differential mounting front insulator if dimension 'A' is 9 mm (0.35 in) or greater, or 2 mm (0.08 in) or smaller (unloaded).

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-31 Removing insulator from differential mounting member
diagrams.description: Pressing the rubber insulator out of the differential mounting member using drift ST33260010.
measurements_and_specs: Special tool: ST33260010
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use ST33260010 for removal of differential mounting member rubber insulator.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-32 Installing insulator to differential mounting member
diagrams.description: Pressing a new rubber insulator into the differential mounting member using drift ST33260020.
measurements_and_specs: Special tool: ST33260020
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use ST33260020 for installation of differential mounting member rubber insulator.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-33 Removing differential mounting front member
diagrams.description: Removing differential front crossmember fasteners, transverse link inner bolts, and damper plate bolts.

callouts.3: Differential mount front insulator installation nut
callouts.4: Differential mounting front member installation nuts
callouts.A: Tightening torque: 14 to 16 kg-m (101 to 116 ft-lb)
callouts.B: Tightening torque: 1.6 to 2.1 kg-m (12 to 15 ft-lb)
callouts.C: Tightening torque: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
callouts.D: Tightening torque: 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)

measurements_and_specs: Inner bolts 1 / Torque A: 14 to 16 kg-m (101 to 116 ft-lb)
Damper plate bolts 2 / Torque B: 1.6 to 2.1 kg-m (12 to 15 ft-lb)
Front insulator nut 3 / Torque C: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
Front member nuts 4 / Torque D: 4.6 to 6.1 kg-m (33 to 44 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Support differential case with jack before removing member nuts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-34 Removing transverse link
diagrams.description: Unbolting rear link mounting bracket to dismount the transverse link from the chassis.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tighten to 3.2 to 4.3 kg-m (23 to 31 ft-lb) on reassembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-35 Removing transverse link outer bushing
diagrams.description: Using Rear Transverse Link Bushing Replacer ST38800000 in a press to extract the spindle outer rubber bushing.

callouts.ST38800000: Rear transverse link bushing replacer ST38800000

measurements_and_specs: Special tool: ST38800000
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not tap end face of bushing directly with a hammer as deformation may result in loose bolt.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-36 Cross-sectional view of transverse link inner bushing (I)
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional view showing proper horizontal alignment of inner bushing projection along the link shaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Align projection on bushing (directed to the axis direction) horizontally. Align center of bushing to center of bracket.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-37 Cross-sectional view of transverse link inner bushing (II)
diagrams.description: Cross section A-A showing clamp assembly of transverse link inner bushing into the differential front member bracket.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: First, tighten bolts supported in vertical direction. Temporarily tighten inner bolts, and final-tighten with vehicle under standard load on ground.

diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-38 Removing stabilizer
diagrams.description: Removing the rear stabilizer bar clamp bracket from the chassis side member.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove main muffler prior to stabilizer bar removal.

diagrams.file: markdown/1978 280z FSM/diagrams/RA Rear axle and Suspension/fig_ra_39_rubber_bushing.png
diagrams.caption: Fig. RA-39 Rubber bushing
diagrams.description: Orientation diagram of stabilizer mounting rubber bushing showing location and direction of alignment dent.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Make sure that the dent in rubber bushing faces towards the rear upper side.

diagrams.caption: Rear axle stand (KV40101000 / Kent-Moore J 25604-01)
diagrams.description: Rear axle stand adapter plate tool used for holding hub and slide hammer extraction.
components: Rear axle stand plate with handle and slotted lug holes
measurements_and_specs: Tool number: KV40101000
Kent-Moore No.: J 25604-01
Ref: Fig. RA-4, Fig. RA-5
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bolts to rear wheel studs to hold flange while loosening locknut or pulling axle.

diagrams.caption: Sliding hammer (ST36230000 / Kent-Moore J 25840)
diagrams.description: Sliding hammer puller tool for removing rear axle shaft from bearing housing.
measurements_and_specs: Tool number: ST36230000
Kent-Moore No.: J 25840
Ref: Fig. RA-5
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Attaches to KV40101000 to pull axle shaft out of housing.

diagrams.caption: Rear transverse link bushing replacer (ST38800000 / Kent-Moore J 25875) with drift ① and support ring ②
diagrams.description: Transverse link outer bushing replacement tool set including drift ST38800010 and support ring ST38800020.
measurements_and_specs: Tool set: ST38800000
Kent-Moore No.: J 25875
Ref: Fig. RA-35
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use in hydraulic press to replace transverse link outer bushing without damaging the link.

diagrams.caption: Rear axle shaft outer bearing drift (ST37780000 / Kent-Moore J 25863)
diagrams.description: Cylindrical bearing driver drift for installing outer rear wheel bearing onto axle shaft.
measurements_and_specs: Tool number: ST37780000
Kent-Moore No.: J 25863
Ref: Page RA-5
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Applies press force evenly to bearing inner race when fitting outer bearing onto axle shaft.

diagrams.caption: Diff. mounting member insulator drift set (ST33260000 / Kent-Moore J25808) with ① Adapter insulator drift (1) ST33260010 and ② Adapter insulator drift (2) ST33260020
diagrams.description: Differential mounting member insulator drift tool set with adapter drifts for removal and installation.
components: ST33260010 Adapter insulator drift (1) for removal
ST33260020 Adapter insulator drift (2) for installation

callouts.1: ST33260010 Adapter insulator drift (1) for removal
callouts.2: ST33260020 Adapter insulator drift (2) for installation

measurements_and_specs: Tool set: ST33260000
Kent-Moore No.: J25808
Ref: Fig. RA-31, Fig. RA-32
diagrams.mechanic_notes: ST33260010 used for removing insulator; ST33260020 used for pressing new insulator into mounting member.

diagrams.caption: Flare nut torque wrench (GG94310000)
diagrams.description: Specialized flare nut wrench adapters for torque-tightening brake tubing nuts without rounding hex corners.
measurements_and_specs: Tool number: GG94310000
Kent-Moore No.: —
Ref: Page RA-9
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Always use flare nut torque wrench when tightening brake tubing connections.
